Subject: ASA Staff Changes


ASA has had a series of staff changes and so would like to confirm the following for any University personnel who may not already be aware - Melanie Jackson left her role as ASA Advertising Manager in December, Dan Markham left his position as ASA Satellite Editor in February. Nigel Green, the ASA General Manager is acting for both roles until replacements can be found, so any queries should be sent directly to him. Finally, Bronwyn Porter has completed her contract as ASA Event Manager and is replaced by Sikander Gore who is also ASA Bar Manager. All email contact details and internal extensions remain the same.

Regards
